Choose the epithelial cluster for the donor-level age model.

Source: R/select_de_cluster.R
select_de_cluster.Rd

k-means labels are arbitrary: they change with the seed, the cell cap, and the gene selection. The cluster is chosen by a screen.

Usage

select_de_cluster(
  pb_se,
  de_formula,
  min_cells_per_class = 150L,
  min_samples_per_class = 5L,
  min_cell_fraction = 0.25,
  min_datasets_spanning_age = 2L
)

Arguments

pb_se

A SummarizedExperiment of sample-by-cluster pseudobulks, with epi_cluster, sample_id, dataset_id, age_binary, and ncells in the column data, and a counts assay.

de_formula

The design used for the expression model, for example ~ age_binary + log_cell_count + dataset_id.

min_cells_per_class

Minimum cells in each age class.

min_samples_per_class

Minimum samples in each age class.

min_cell_fraction

Minimum share of cells in each age class.

min_datasets_spanning_age

Minimum number of studies that contribute donors of both age classes.

Value

A list with cluster, the chosen label, and screen, the table the choice was made from.

Details

A cluster qualifies when both age classes are well represented and the age effect is separable from the study effect. If every study in a cluster supplies a single age class, age is a linear combination of the study indicators and no age coefficient can be separated from a study effect. Among clusters that qualify, the one supported by the most studies that contribute both age classes is chosen, then the one with the most pseudobulk columns. Ties break on the label.
